archetypes.name: dyn-trailer-semantics
archetypes.rationale: Difficulty fallback must not weaken strict trailer validation or mask invalid adjacent metadata.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the difficulty metadata helpers and validator call sites. Focus on the ordering between strict trailing detection, adjacent invalid metadata suppression, and whole-document fallback. Check edge cases where legacy confidence lines, blank lines, or missing diff_lines could accidentally accept or reject the wrong tier. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
